name: Performance Analytics
summary: Expanded October 20. The program combines aircraft health monitoring data, operational data and maintenance history, and Gulfstream's engineers and analytics specialists turn it into proactive maintenance, service and spare parts recommendations. Gulfstream says it has helped address nearly 100 potential operational events before they happened this year, and expects to more than double its analytics capabilities in the first half of 2027 as it adds aircraft systems and models.

whyItMatters: An event caught early becomes a planned fix instead of a cancelled trip. Gulfstream operators should ask which systems and models are covered today, how recommendations reach their maintenance team, and whether parts are positioned before the work is due.
pricing: Gulfstream Customer Support program; contact Gulfstream
